## Use case

What are you trying to do, and what is missing today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you would like to see. For a study, include public calculation rules and required data. For a provider, include its official API documentation and authentication/data requirements.

## Alternatives

Mention any existing workaround and relevant item in [the roadmap](https://github.com/RoryNaught/open-market-charts/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md).
